maddeler.e:
اقترفوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَفُوا (iqtarafū) /iq.ta.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# اُقْتُرِفُوا (uqturifū) /uq.tu.ri.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# اِقْتَرِفُوا (iqtarifū) /iq.ta.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
